title: A clear pronunciation breakdown
description: Compare your recording with the model and get a specific explanation, keeping a recognition error apart from a note about your speech.

blocks.text: A red “wrong” indicator doesn’t explain which sound to change. A person repeats the word at random and stops trusting the score, especially when a deliberately wrong attempt is accepted too.

quote.text: when I pronounce correctly it says it’s wrong and sometimes when I say it wrong the screen says that I did it right

blocks.text: In the exercise the model, your own recording and the text of what was recognized are all available side by side. The correction points to a specific spot; after a repeat you can listen to both attempts. Uncertain recognition isn’t passed off as a proven pronunciation mistake.

First a checked set of words and phrases in a single variety of the language is needed. The corrections should be compared with a teacher’s judgment. If the system can’t tell a good attempt from a wrong one, an elegant comparison of recordings doesn’t make it a reliable teacher.
